newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian Nestle stock hot after results.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian Nestle stock hot after results.

text.p: Nestle Foods Nigeria Plc's share price rose by the maximum permitted five percent on Monday after it posted an impressive full-year results, dealers said.
Nestle chalked up a 3.53 naira gain to close at 74.13 naira, replacing oil marketer Unipetrol as the highest priced stock on the Nigerian bourse.
"Suddenly Nestle stock just seems so dear and everyone wants a slice," said one trader, referring to the scramble to buy following the release of the company's 1996 results.
After tax profits in the year to end-December 1996 doubled to 1.2 billion naira from 612.8 million for the previous year.
Turnover was 6.1 billion naira from 4.4 billion last year.
Nestle products include Maggi soup and stew seasonings, noodles, cereals and Milo food drink.
Nestle S.A. of Switzerland owns at least 40 percent of shares in the company while the rest of the stock is held by Nigerians.
